body:
UltraBubbles618 made a racist remark. What happened:

Someone in my school was acting inappropriate, and I told him about it. He agreed with me on her being inappropriate and trying to attention. I tell him how this person if african american and he said something that I forget. I ask him do you have anything against african americans or her being african american and he said "Yes". A mod by the name of SawViper  heard it so there is my witness and please ask him. Also this was over teamspeak and after this he said f**** you and f*** you guys. Please perm ban him over teamspeak not just because of this comment but because he has been rude the last view days/hours. I am not enjoying my return on avicus because of this.

  Thank you for your time,
                                             - ArkhamJoshFTW
